name: XWesternUnion
caption: Əlavə modullar / Ödənişlər və köçürmələr / Western Union

datasets.name: AccountPrincipial
datasets.sql:
Select
   wu.RowID,
   wu.*,
   v.val_name,
   a.acc_no,
   wb.branchname
from
  wu_accounts wu,
  avalute v,
  account a,
  wu_branch wb
where
  wu.currency = v.valute and
  wu.accid=a.id and
  accounttype = 0 and
  wu.branchid = wb.branchid
order by currency

datasets.name: AccountRevenue
datasets.sql:
Select
   wu.RowID,
   wu.*,
   v.val_name,
   a.acc_no,
   wb.branchname
from
  wu_accounts wu,
  avalute v,
  account a,
  wu_branch wb
where
  wu.currency = v.valute and
  wu.accid=a.id and
  accounttype = 1 and
  wu.branchid = wb.branchid
order by currency

datasets.name: DataWUIncoming
datasets.sql:
Select
  w.RowID,
  w.*,
  v.val_name as valute,
  wb.BranchName,
  wb.BranchID
From
  WU_Incoming w,
  avalute v,
  wu_branch wb
where
  w.currency = v.valute(+) and
  w.branch = wb.symbol(+) and
  incomdate
  between :stDate and :EnDate
  order by :Title

datasets.name: DataAccount
datasets.sql:
Select 
   *
from 
  Account 
where 
  close_dat is null

datasets.name: DataReport
datasets.sql:
Select
  w.Kind "Gəl-Ged",
  incomdate "Tarix",
  reference "Qeydiyyat №",
  principial "Məbləğ",
  revenue "Gəlir",
  v.val_name  "Valuta",
  wb.BranchName "Filial",
  wb.BranchId  BranchId
From
  WU_Incoming w,
  avalute v,
  wu_branch wb
where
  w.currency = v.valute(+) and
  w.branch = wb.symbol(+)and
  incomdate
  between :stDate and :EnDate

order by wb.BranchName, w.Kind

datasets.name: DataReportComplex
datasets.sql:
Select
   nom "№",
   branch "Bölmənin adı",
   transcount "Əməliyyatların sayı",
   amount_i "Ödənilmiş məbləğ",
   amount_o "Qəbul olunmuş məbləğ",
   revenue "Qəlir"
From
  WU_REPORT
order by 
  nom
